findings.current: One person had slaughtered more than four hundred mounted bandits.
findings.defect: The assembled copy changes the stated quantity from four hundred to more than four hundred.
findings.rationale: The source here says 사백, exactly four hundred, unlike the earlier 사백이 넘는, which explicitly means more than four hundred.
findings.replacement: One person had slaughtered four hundred mounted bandits.

findings.current: His left arm had been torn apart as though devoured by a beast
findings.defect: The source says his left arm had been torn off, not merely torn apart.
findings.rationale: 뜯겨 describes the arm being ripped away; this is reinforced later by references to his one remaining arm and the attacker tearing the arm off.
findings.replacement: His left arm had been torn off as though devoured by a beast

findings.current: The Jin Family Branch Leader sent internal energy toward his wrist.
findings.defect: The direction of the action is weakened: he channels internal energy into the man's wrist pulse rather than merely toward his wrist.
findings.rationale: 완맥을 향해 공력을 흘려 보냈다 describes sending internal energy through/into the wrist pulse to briefly restore clarity.
findings.replacement: The Jin Family Branch Leader channeled internal energy into his wrist pulse.

findings.current: At the same time, his one remaining hand seized the Branch Leader by the collar.
findings.defect: The translation omits that the surviving hand pulled the Branch Leader's collar toward him.
findings.rationale: 옷깃을 끌어당겼다 explicitly means that he pulled the collar, a physical action that leads into the Branch Leader trying to wrench himself away.
findings.replacement: At the same time, his one remaining hand seized the Branch Leader's collar and yanked him closer.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with four minor defects involving quantity and physical action.
